basic_details.short_information: Haryana State Electronics Development Corporation Limited (HARTRON) has released the HARTRON DEO Recruitment 2026 notification for the updation of its panel of Data Entry Operators (DEO) on a job work basis. A total of 110 positions have been announced across seven districts of Haryana, including Panchkula, Gurugram, Jhajjar, Karnal, Palwal, Rewari and Sonepat.

content_sections.heading: HARTRON DEO Vacancy 2026 - District Wise Post Details
content_sections.text: HARTRON has announced 110 Data Entry Operator panel positions across seven districts of Haryana. Panchkula has the highest allocation with 50 positions, while six other districts have 10 positions each. The district-wise details are provided below:

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply for HARTRON DEO Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Candidates interested in HARTRON Data Entry Operator positions must satisfy the educational, computer knowledge and other eligibility requirements prescribed by the organisation. The uploaded short notification does not provide detailed qualification requirements. Educational Qualification: Candidates must possess the qualifications specified in the detailed HARTRON DEO notification. Computer Knowledge: Applicants should check the prescribed computer education or certification requirements in the detailed eligibility criteria. Typing / Data Entry Skills: Candidates should verify the applicable typing speed or data entry requirements before applying. District Preference: Each candidate is permitted to apply for only one district. Reservation: Empanelment will be carried out according to the Haryana State Reservation Policy. Candidates are advised to check the detailed eligibility conditions on the official HARTRON website before applying.

content_sections.heading: HARTRON DEO Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Minimum Age: As per the detailed notification. Maximum Age: As per HARTRON Recruitment Rules. Age Relaxation: As applicable under the relevant government rules and recruitment conditions.

content_sections.heading: HARTRON DEO Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

content_sections.heading: HARTRON DEO Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
content_sections.text: HARTRON will conduct a test for preparing the Data Entry Operator panel. The test will be organised at the designated examination centres in Ambala and Gurugram. Test Centres: IDDC, Ambala and HMSDC, Gurugram. Admit Card: Candidates can download their admit cards from 01 December 2026 onwards through the official website. Panel Preparation: Candidates who satisfy the prescribed requirements and successfully complete the selection process may be included in the panel. Panel Validity: The panel will remain valid for two years from the publication date of the result. HARTRON may extend its validity if required. Deployment: Empanelled candidates may be deployed when a confirmed requirement is received from the requesting organisation. Note: Qualifying in the test and being included in the panel does not guarantee employment or deployment. HARTRON reserves the right to vary or cancel positions depending on requirements.
